info.title: RuehrAI API
info.description:
Dev-Team slice (v0). The backend issues its own JWTs and reads a local
Postgres database via `DATABASE_URL`. Clients call this API; they do not
talk to the database.

Base URL is environment-driven. Local default is `http://localhost:3000`
(`PORT`, default 3000). Deployed clients should take the base URL from
their own configuration and use this document as the contract.

Local migrations seed a development user `dev@ruehrai.local` /
`dev-password`. That account is a fixture for local runs, not a production
credential. `POST /auth/register` creates further users in `app.users`.
`POST /auth/logout` revokes that access token until it expires.

Customer inputs (target region, store addresses, monthly revenue) are
stored in schema `app` and are visible only to the user id in the token.

Analysis (0.3.0) snapshots that input, reads kleinräumige Brain facts for
the target region, and persists a pattern (criteria and direction).
Recommendations (0.4.0) rank up to three locations in that region where
the saved pattern fits over the last six calendar months, and attach a
German rationale per location. Clients call only this API.

servers.description: Local development. The host and port follow the backend `PORT` env (default 3000).

get.description: Process is up. This check does not query Postgres.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for a JWT
post.description:
Returns a bearer token. Local databases seeded by `db/migrations`
include `dev@ruehrai.local` / `dev-password`.

post.summary: Create a user and return a JWT
post.description:
Password hashing is done in Postgres (`pgcrypto` bcrypt) and the row is
stored in `app.users`. Minimum password length is 8. The response matches
`POST /auth/login`.

200.description: User row for the token subject.

post.description:
Requires `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Stores the token id
(`jti`) in `app.revoked_tokens` until the token's own expiry. A later
request with the same token is `401`. Clients should also drop the
token locally. This is the Slice-1 session end: JWTs stay stateless
apart from this denylist. There is no refresh token.

204.description: Token revoked. The body is empty.

400.description: The token has no revocable id.

get.summary: Read the signed-in user's target region
get.description:
One region per user, the area where they want to open a new store.
`404` when nothing has been saved yet.

404.description: This user has not saved a target region.

put.summary: Create or replace the target region
put.description:
Upserts the single region for the token's user. Omitted geo fields are
stored as null, including fields set by a previous save.

delete.description: Idempotent. Responds `204` even when no region was stored.

204.description: Target region cleared. The body is empty.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's store addresses

200.description: Stores owned by the token's user, oldest first.

post.description:
German address (`postalCode` is PLZ5, `countryCode` is `DE`).
`street` includes the house number.

get.description: 404 when the id is missing or belongs to another user.

200.description: Store owned by the token's user.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.
No store with this id for the token's user.

delete.description: Also deletes monthly revenue for that store.

204.description: Store deleted. The body is empty.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

get.description:
Points the customer has saved, ordered by year then month. A point with
`revenueEur: null` was explicitly marked missing. A month with no point
was not entered. At most 36 points are stored per store.

200.description: Saved months. Empty `points` when none have been entered.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

put.description:
Inserts or replaces each `(year, month)` in the body. Other saved months
stay. `revenueEur: null` marks that month as missing. The store can hold
at most 36 months; a request that would exceed that returns `400` and
changes nothing.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

delete.description:
`204` when the store exists, including when that month was not stored.
`404` when the store is missing or belongs to another user.

204.description: Month removed, or it was not stored. The body is empty.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

get.summary: Search places by name, grain, or geo key
get.description:
Reads `features.v_location_search` when that view contains at least one row.
Filters apply to name, title, grain, and geo_key. `lon` and `lat` are
JSON null when the row has no coordinates.

`q` is a substring. `type` limits `q` to grain `ags`, `plz5`/`plz8`, or
`address`. Without `type`, `q` matches name, title, and geo_key.
`type` has no effect when `q` is omitted.

`ags` and `plz` are exact geo_key matches on that grain. `geoKey` is an
exact geo_key match on any grain. `grain` is exact. `address` is a
substring of name, title, and geo_key. Filters combine with AND.
At most 50 hits, ordered by label.

If the view is missing or has no rows (local docker-compose), the same
filters run against the seeded `app.search_places` catalog.
Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326) when present.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Field that `q` is matched against. Ignored when `q` is absent.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Substring matched against the address and the label.

200.description: Matching hits, at most 50, ordered by label.

get.description:
Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection as `application/json`.
Layer rows stay in schema `app` (`map_layers`, `map_features`) until
feature documents have coordinates. Seeded layer ids in local dev:
`demo-gemeinden`, `demo-plz`, `demo-grid100`.
Geometries are synthetic stubs for this slice (points, plus one rough polygon),
not official boundaries. Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326), longitude then latitude.

200.description: Layer contents. An existing layer with no features returns an empty `features` array.

get.summary: Structured analysis input for the signed-in user
get.description:
Builds the Musteranalyse input from the user's saved target region,
store addresses, and monthly revenue (at most 36 months per store).
A revenue change counts only between two successive calendar months
that both have a non-null amount. `404` when no target region is
saved. `400` when no store has two adjacent months with revenue.

200.description: Input that a run would snapshot.

400.description: Region exists, but monthly revenue is not sufficient.

example.message: Die Monatsumsätze reichen für eine Musteranalyse nicht aus. Mindestens eine Filiale braucht zwei aufeinanderfolgende Monate mit gesetztem Umsatz.

404.description: This user has not saved a target region.

example.message: Keine Zielregion gespeichert. Bitte zuerst eine Zielregion anlegen.

post.summary: Snapshot input, search Brain, and persist a pattern
post.description:
Same preconditions as `GET /analysis/input`. On success the run is
stored for this user and includes the Brain facts used (region filter,
plus store postal codes) and the derived pattern. The pattern is the
input a later Top-3 step can read. This operation does not recommend
addresses.

400.description: Monthly revenue is not sufficient for a pattern.

404.description: This user has not saved a target region.

get.summary: Read one analysis run of the signed-in user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id as a decimal string.

200.description: The run, including input, Brain facts, and pattern.

404.description: No run with this id for the token's user.

get.summary: Latest persisted pattern for the signed-in user
get.description:
Returns the pattern from the newest completed run. `404` when the
user has not completed an analysis yet.

404.description: No completed analysis run for this user.

example.message: Es liegt noch kein Muster vor. Bitte zuerst eine Analyse starten.

post.summary: Rank up to three locations for the signed-in user
post.description:
Reads a completed Musteranalyse pattern for this user (the newest run,
or `runId` when set) and searches Brain locations in the target region.
A location ranks when at least one pattern criterion with a direction
moved the same way inside the six UTC calendar months ending in the
request month. Score is the share of those directional criteria that
match. The response has at most three items, ordered by score.

One or two matches are success, not an error: `reason` explains the
thin region in German. Zero matches are also success, with `reason`
set and `items` empty. `404` when this user has no completed pattern,
or when `runId` is not one of their runs.

The region anchor itself is omitted when a finer positive location
exists. Finer grains match when their `geo_key` is under the region
key or their metadata names the region (`geo_ags`, `ags`, `plz`,
`geo_plz`, `geo_key`). Each item's `rationale` is German and grounded
in `criteriaEvidence`. `source` is `llm` when that text came from the
local model, otherwise `heuristic`.

201.description: Persisted recommendation set for this user.

example.reason: In der Zielregion liegt nur 1 Standort mit positiver Musterentwicklung in den letzten sechs Monaten vor.

criteria.label: einwohner
criteria.evidence: einwohner steigt zwischen den vorliegenden Zeiträumen.

items.title: Schwabing
items.rationale: Am Standort Schwabing (80801) passt das Muster in den letzten sechs Monaten. Quelle: Heuristik, ohne Sprachmodell.

criteriaEvidence.label: einwohner
criteriaEvidence.evidence: einwohner steigt in den letzten sechs Monaten (2026-04: 10; 2026-09: 20).

404.description: No completed analysis pattern for this user, or the run id is not theirs.

value.message: Es liegt noch kein Muster vor. Bitte zuerst eine Analyse starten.

unknownRun.summary: runId is missing for this user

get.summary: Latest recommendation set for the signed-in user
get.description:
Returns the newest set stored by `POST /recommendations` for the token
user. `404` when this user has not computed recommendations yet.

404.description: This user has no stored recommendations.

example.message: Es liegen noch keine Empfehlungen vor. Bitte zuerst Empfehlungen berechnen.

StoreId.name: id
StoreId.description: Store id as a decimal string.

id.description: User id as a decimal string.

Grain.description: Spatial grain of a hit. Matches the Datenbasis grain list used by this slice.

geoKey.description: Spatial key from the feature view (AGS, PLZ, address id, or grid id). Null when unknown.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude. Omitted or null when the hit is not geocoded.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude. Omitted or null when the hit is not geocoded.

Geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry. This slice seeds Point and Polygon.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates. Position order is longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326).

properties.description: Includes label, grain, and stub: true for seeded demo features.

FeatureCollection.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection. `name` and `description` are foreign members
carried for this API (RFC 7946 allows them).

grain.description: Same values as Grain. Null when the region is a free-text label.

id.description: Store id as a decimal string.

revenueEur.description: EUR. Null means the month was marked missing.

AnalysisInput.description:
Snapshot of customer inputs used for Musteranalyse. `stores[].points`
holds up to 36 months. `changes` links only successive calendar months
that both have a revenue.

changeEur.description: toRevenueEur minus fromRevenueEur, rounded to cents.

RevenueDirection.description: Sign of the summed month-to-month revenue changes. Flat means the sum is zero.

CriterionDirection.description:
Direction of one Brain criterion. `unknown` means the facts do not
show a change over time (often a single reference period).

id.description: Run id as a decimal string.

AnalysisBrain.description:
Facts retrieved for this run. `vector` means cosine similarity over
Brain embeddings, filtered to the target region and store postal
codes. `sql` means the same filters without a vector (embeddings
unset, unreachable, or not usable). This is not a raw Brain dump.

factCount.description: Number of facts included on this run.

excerpt.description: Short prose from the feature document, or the title when no prose is stored.

distance.description: Cosine distance when mode is vector. Null for the SQL filter.

matchedBy.description:
`region` matches the target region ags, plz, or geoKey.
`store` matches a store postal code.
`label` is the text fallback when the region has no geo key.

AnalysisPattern.description:
Persisted pattern for a later Top-3 step. `source` is `llm` when the
criteria were taken from the language model and checked against the
retrieved facts, otherwise `heuristic`.

evidence.description: Grounded in the retrieved Brain facts or the stored revenue series.

RecommendationCreate.description:
Optional body for `POST /recommendations`. Omit `runId` to use the
newest completed analysis run of the token user.

runId.description: Analysis run id as a decimal string. Must belong to the token user.

RecommendationSet.description:
Top-3 payload the web client binds to. `count` is `items.length` and
is never greater than 3. `reason` is null when three positive locations
were available. `pattern` is the snapshot used for this ranking.

id.description: Recommendation set id as a decimal string.

runId.description: Analysis run this set was ranked from.

reason.description:
German explanation when fewer than three locations are returned,
or when the Brain read hit its row limit. Null when three matches
were ranked without truncation.

RecommendationWindow.description:
Six calendar months, inclusive, ending in the UTC month of the request.
Brain `ref_period` values outside this window do not affect the score.

id.description: Stable location id `{grain}:{geoKey}` inside this set.

title.description: Card title. Place name, address line, or geo key from Brain.

score.description:
Share of pattern criteria that have a direction and moved the same
way at this location inside the window. 1 is a full fit.

rationale.description:
German Begründung. Names only criteria and figures present in
`criteriaEvidence`.

source.description:
`llm` when `rationale` was taken from the local model and checked
against `criteriaEvidence`. `heuristic` when the model was unset,
failed, or its text was discarded.

name.description: Brain place name when the row has one.

RecommendationEvidence.description:
One pattern criterion that moved in the pattern direction at this
location. `direction` is what Brain shows in the window.
`patternDirection` is the saved Musteranalyse direction.

evidence.description: German sentence with the months and figures used for the score.
